items.title: How Many Shares of Starbucks, Darden or McDonald’s Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about $439,500 of McDonald’s stock, about $450,500 of Darden Restaurants or about $518,100 of Starbucks. McDonald’s pairs the lowest cost with steady coverage, with its dividend taking 70% of free cash flow over the last 12 months.

items.title: 3 ETFs For Owning Starbucks Without The Same Surrounding Risks
items.summary: You might like Starbucks for its brand and global reach, but buying the stock alone means carrying its specific issues by yourself.
